gratitude.title: Start with one grateful thought
gratitude.content: Write directly in your journal. Start with one thing you appreciate today.

visibility.title: Choose who can see it
visibility.content: Private keeps this note only for you.

save.title: Save your first note
save.content: Save to keep this page. Then view it in your profile or start a new page.

filter.title: Choose your time range
filter.content: Switch between year, six months, month, or week to review your rhythm.

garden.title: Watch your garden grow
garden.content: Colors and symbols show how often you wrote on each day.

month.title: Explore a month
month.content: Move between months, then select a day to focus your view.

moments.title: Return to a day's moments
moments.content: Read the notes from the selected day, or add another moment.

edit.title: Make your profile yours

rhythm.title: See your weekly writing rhythm

entries.title: Revisit what matters
entries.content: Your saved entries are below. Open an entry to revisit what you appreciated.

step1.title: Write a grateful thought
step1.content: Start with something small. Add up to 10 grateful thoughts.

step2.title: A little more about today
step2.content: Write more below your gratitudes. Open extras for mood and place; add photos or decorations if you like.

step3.title: Choose privacy and save
step3.content: Choose who can see this page, then Save.

step1.title: Choose a tool and ink
step1.content: Pick Pen or Highlight, an ink color and stroke size.

step2.title: Write on the paper
step2.content: Write, erase or move the page. Open Customize to zoom; paper and stamps are below the page.

step3.title: Choose privacy and save
step3.content: Choose who can see your handwritten page, then Save.
